gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 concerns multidimensional cells intersecting multiple shock surfaces and inadequate local interpolation assumptions. It does not diagnose the gold defects concerning Gauss–Green and boundary traces for arbitrary measurable sets or the missing h-uniform bound on the L1 gradient norm.

Both discuss cells near shock-related geometry, but ISSUE-003 addresses multidimensional cells near an interaction set and failure of a one-surface construction. It does not recognize the distinct one-dimensional strip-only-cell case or the required aggregate mesh-skeleton estimate for transition-layer contributions.

ISSUE-001 diagnoses impossible exact tanh-network representability of a product expression. It does not recognize that the solution-adapted comparison function may lie outside the constrained test class V_h^c because c is not tied to the solution amplitude.

ISSUE-002 concerns an incorrect compound-wave convergence exponent and omitted proof. It does not identify the missing nonnegativity of the entropy component caused by using a bare supremum over unconstrained raw network outputs.

ISSUE-003 concerns local shock-surface interpolation and cell classification. It does not diagnose the omitted lateral-boundary network-flux term produced by the divergence theorem or the absence of a loss term controlling that flux.

ISSUE-003 recognizes the full geometric construction failure: cells can contain multiple distinct shock surfaces, so the assumed single surface, tangent plane, and one-sided interpolation data are invalid and the cell contribution is unestimated. This is the same underlying multidimensional multi-branch construction weakness as the gold issue, although the prediction presents it through intermediate-cell classification rather than explicitly through shared-face affine-trace compatibility.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The multidimensional CPwL shock competitor is not valid for cells containing multiple separated shock branches: a single tangent-plane transition construction and associated one-sided traces cannot represent the geometry, leaving the cell estimates and the claimed global construction unsupported.
gold_decisions.uncovered_gold_detail: The prediction does not spell out the common-face affine-trace compatibility failure or the branchwise conforming-refinement repair, but no substantive gold concern is left unrecognised.

component_coverage.gold_component: Multiple shock branches can occur in one background cell, invalidating the assumed single tangent-plane/one-layer CPwL construction and leaving continuity and cell estimates unsupported.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly identifies cells intersecting two shock surfaces, explains that the one-surface/tangent-plane and one-sided-trace assumptions fail, and states that the resulting cell contributions are not estimated.
